_meta.domain_name: Baseball Team and Player Data Governance
_meta.definition: The process of managing, maintaining, and governing data related to teams, players, awards, statistics, and other baseball-related information.

TeamsFranchises._description: Captures historical information about Major League Baseball franchises, including their identifiers, names, activity status, and association with North American baseball.

columns.name: franchID
columns.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each row in TeamsFranchises

columns.name: franchName
columns.description: Stores the unique names of baseball franchises, often representing different iterations or relocations of a team.

columns.name: active
columns.description: Indicates the current active status of each franchise (N denotes inactive).

columns.name: NAassoc
columns.description: NAassoc column stores initials of National Association (NAL) or American League (AL) or National League (NL) or Continental League (CL) for baseball franchises.
